caption: The drawing shows a single, centrally placed object resembling a metal tool or weapon on a plain, light beige background. The object is horizontally oriented, with a long, thin, pointed shaft that gradually narrows to a sharp tip on the left side. The right end of the object features a closed, oval-shaped handle and a perpendicular upward extension with a hook at the top. The object appears dark brown, almost black, with variations in shading suggesting a metallic sheen and some wear. The background is plain, with a faint rectangular border drawn around the object. The bottom left corner has the handwritten text "Actual Size," and the bottom right has the name "Edgar Miller."
title: Candle Holder
